column1: # moved-repositories.tsv — estate repositories that were transferred or renamed, and the name a caller must use now.
# former and current are `owner/repo`; repo_id is GitHub's numeric id, which a transfer keeps (it is how the two names are known to be one repository).
# Consumed by scripts/fix-stale-reusable-pin.sh: a table row for either name matches a caller written with either name, and a caller still
# written with the former name is rewritten to the current one. A reusable `uses:` does NOT follow GitHub's redirect — a caller of the former
# name dies at startup_failure whatever its SHA — so moving only the SHA would leave it dead.
# Mirrored by hypatia (Hypatia.Rules.MovedRepositories, rule WF028) so detection and repair carry the same facts.

column4: transferred 2026-10-25; a reusable call of the former name fails at startup (hypatia WF028)
